budget_title: Noise budget at the input, on the chip
budget: AFE: every device and resistor of the chip at the operating point its wiring gives the AFE (pad cells, straps, the bias ground offset; afe_chip_noise.py on r12's wiring, AFE_IBIAS 3, Monte Carlo 30: 5.34 ± 0.07 nV rms, worst die 5.50 nV rms, 16.41 bit). ADC and blanking as budgeted on 10/26. ADC poly flicker: RIN and DAC1 at full scale, on ppolyf_u since r11 (4.15 nV rms and 16.26 bit with r10's ppolyf_u_1k). Until 9 Nov the total also had a pads-and-straps line (1.5 nV rms) that the AFE line already holds.
afe_noise: Harmonic-sum gain 287.3 V/V in the schematic, 284.8 V/V extracted, 282.9 V/V on the chip. The rise comes from the larger input-node capacitance, the input-path wiring, and on the chip the AFE's operating point there (bias ground offset, pad cells), typical, AFE_IBIAS 3. r12's afe_top (corridor shield, WN sheet off the clock rows) adds 2 mΩ to WN: +0.001 nV rms.
checks_sub: DRC, LVS with two tools, pad-ring, supply and crossing checks, wafer.space precheck, Magic and digital verification · 24 Oct – 13 Nov 2026
checks: Precheck pre_20261113_r12: --slot 1x0p5 --cob as the shuttle specifies, latest image (20 Oct, PDK 792ef670; still the latest on 13 Nov). The pad-ring checks and the whole-chip LVS came in on 29 Oct, after the core's DVDD was found cut from its pads in r0–r7; the tap check on 9 Nov, after the quantizer's latch ground was found open in r0–r9; the crossing census on 13 Nov, after switching lines were found under the ADC's I1N / O1P straps and the AFE's WN in r11. Since r11 the netlist for Netgen writes m > 1 resistors strip by strip (Netgen 1.5.323 merges them in series inconsistently).
rwire: Final layout: E and T measured on the r9 chip (pex_rin.py; unchanged since), W on r12's afe_top (WN 0.359 Ω, 2 mΩ above r11 after the WN Metal5 over the clock rows was cut back). T was set by the auto-routed gate wiring of the input pair before the D6 fixes. The per-side target for 16.50 bit (0.35 Ω) is for this chip wiring; the pad cells' own Metal2 (asig_5p0, two in parallel per electrode, 0.636 Ω per side, found on 27 Oct) comes on top: 1.27 / 1.33 Ω per side.
metrics: AFE: afe_top's r12 extraction (corridor shield, WN sheet off the clock rows); gain from the ±0.5 mV chopped transient (200 µs). ADC: the schematic (RIN, DAC1 and R21 on ppolyf_u since r11) and the final column with C1 and C2 x1.25 (the r12 extraction of adc_top); loop at 20 kHz, 0.3 V pk, 100 µs, evaluated over 20–100 µs (80 frames); DAC1's even-order error from its own block's extraction (r11, unchanged in r12). Behavioural SNDR: ELD 0.22 of a clock (reproduces the transistor loop), typical, the one element's charge on every element. The 10/23 column is that day's extraction and model (ELD 3/32).
